summary: The end-to-end ML platform landscape in 2026 is dominated by the three hyperscaler offerings (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, and Google's Vertex AI, now folded into the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), with Databricks emerging as a cross-cloud 'Data Intelligence Platform' rival. GigaOm's enterprise readiness benchmark scores Azure ML highest (2.95/3), followed by SageMaker (2.83/3) and Vertex AI (2.12/3), while the broader MLOps market ($4.39B in 2026, projected to reach $89.91B by 2034 at 45.8% CAGR) also includes specialized players like DataRobot, H2O.ai, Weights & Biases, Dataiku, and Domino Data Lab. You need a full platform when you must train/fine-tune custom models, track experiments, govern the full lifecycle, and deploy at scale with compliance; if you only need inference on a frontier model, a hosted model API is far simpler and cheaper.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go based on underlying compute (VM/GPU hours), storage, and managed endpoints; no separate platform fee. Enterprise agreements available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already in the Microsoft ecosystem needing strong governance, lifecycle management, and the highest enterprise-readiness score (GigaOm 2.95/3).

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per second for instances (notebooks, training, inference endpoints), plus storage and data processing; no upfront cost. Savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams wanting a modular 'ML workshop' with leading production deployment capabilities and deep S3/IAM integration (GigaOm 2.83/3).

platforms.name: Databricks (Mosaic AI + MLflow)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU (Databricks Unit) pricing on top of cloud compute; tiered by workload type. Enterprise commit contracts available.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting a unified data + AI 'Data Intelligence Platform' across multiple clouds, with lakehouse/Delta workloads and MLflow-centered ML lifecycle.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go for training/prediction compute, pipelines, and feature store; frontier model usage billed per token/character. No platform fee.
platforms.best_for: GCP-centric teams needing tightly integrated feature store, opinionated pipelines, and managed Gemini/GenAI and agent workflows (GigaOm 2.12/3, governance gaps noted).

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/license (custom quote); consumption-based options for some deployments.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises that want managed AutoML and governance without building MLOps engineering overhead in-house.

platforms.name: Dataiku
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription licensing (custom quote); free edition available for small teams.
platforms.best_for: Cross-functional teams (data scientists + analysts) wanting a collaborative, visual end-to-end data science and ML platform.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases (CoreWeave)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; team and enterprise subscription plans priced per seat/usage.
platforms.best_for: ML/research teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking, reproducibility, and model evaluation layered on top of any training infrastructure.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core (H2O-3) free; enterprise products (Driverless AI, H2O AI Cloud) via subscription/custom quote.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting strong AutoML and open-source flexibility plus enterprise GenAI tooling.

platforms.name: Domino Data Lab
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises (finance, pharma, life sciences) needing reproducible, governed data science across hybrid/on-prem infrastructure.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions available via Databricks and cloud vendors.
platforms.best_for: Teams with DevOps skills wanting an open, vendor-neutral standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; infrastructure costs only.
platforms.best_for: Kubernetes-native teams with strong DevOps capability wanting portable, open MLOps without vendor lock-in.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; generous free credits for new users.
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting fast, serverless GPU compute for training/fine-tuning and deploying models without managing infrastructure.
